title: Annex V to CP draft ITS under Art. 31(2) AMLD - Cross-Border Report

paras.text: FOR CROSS-BORDER REPORTS

Fields marked with * are mandatory, and must always be completed, while fields marked with ** are conditional mandatory and must be completed only when relevant or when the related information is available to the disclosing FIU. Fields marked with *** shall be replicated as necessary on a case-by-case basis.
